response.message: Astra: Your latest note adds “revisit experiences,” but the visible follow-up mostly adds principles. Which moment in making this note is worth replaying, and why spend attention there rather than polishing the list? Focus on what you actually did after receiving guidance, not just what you agreed to do. What does that comparison support carrying forward, and what remains an untested intention?
response.rationale: Interrupts generic summary growth and invites selective replay grounded in the difference between stated strategy and visible behavior.
